name: AR_APP_RULE_DETAILS
description: The AR_APP_RULE_DETAILS table stores detailed information about an application rule, including amounts rounding, tax treatment, and line type. For example, if you define an application rule to prorate partial payments across all line types, a record in this table would have Line in the LINE_TYPE column and Prorate in the TAX_TREATMENT column.  . The primary key for this table is RULE_DETAIL_ID.

columns.name: RULE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Rule set identifier.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Rule identifier.

columns.name: ROUNDING_CORRECTION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this rule contains amounts that rounding corrections create or not.

columns.name: TAX_TREATMENT
columns.description: Tax handling information for this rule, prorate, before, after, or none.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: The line type for this rule, line, freight, or charges

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
